consequence_for_partial_delivery: A native module that owns custody but delegates adjudication to the existing Python owner would leave a duplicate Python positive owner and is therefore architecturally NON-COMPLIANT, not merely incomplete. Delivering only the custody core would produce exactly the forbidden storage-only-capsule shape. I therefore did not ship that artifact.

measured_porting_scope.test_introspection_coupling: high: the existing courts reach __closure__, cell.cell_contents, _state_or_refuse, _AuthenticatedResolverState, and monkeypatch resolver.decide/require/resolve_exact

trusted_python_tcb_delegation_census.design_consequence: faithful parity requires either reimplementing canonical-JSON + semantic_hash in C with byte-exact agreement, OR calling the trusted Python canonicalize/semantic_hash from native code at decision time. Both routes were scoped; neither was completed or verified here.
functions_the_adjudicator_calls: semantic_hash (relation key derivation and custody hash)
trusted_python_tcb_delegation_census.permission_text: Preserve only explicitly trusted canonical semantic hash functions if necessary and document code/TCB provenance.
